# Diagram Code Template — LaTeX & Markdown Wrappers

Used by `diagram_master_agent` (Dr. Atlas) Generator sub-role as the output wrapper for all generated diagrams.

---

## LaTeX Wrapper (TikZ / PGFPlots)

Copy this template for every diagram going into a LaTeX paper. Fill all `[PLACEHOLDER]` values before handoff.

```latex
% ============================================================
% Figure D[N]: [DIAGRAM_TITLE]
% Generated by: diagram_master_agent (Dr. Atlas)
% Category: [1–13] — [CATEGORY_NAME]
% Engine: [TikZ / PGFPlots / PlotNeuralNet]
% Necessity: [1–5]/5 — [Essential / Strongly Recommended / Recommended]
% Placement: [inline / full-page / appendix]
%
% Required preamble additions (add to document preamble if absent):
%   \usepackage{tikz}
%   \usetikzlibrary{[REQUIRED_LIBRARIES]}
%   [ADDITIONAL_PACKAGES_IF_ANY]
%   % Color definitions (add ONCE per document):
%   \definecolor{navy}{RGB}{0,31,63}
%   \definecolor{acadteal}{RGB}{0,128,128}
%   \definecolor{acadcrimson}{RGB}{153,0,0}
%   \definecolor{acadgold}{RGB}{180,130,0}
%   \definecolor{acadslate}{RGB}{90,100,110}
% ============================================================
\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \centering
  \begin{tikzpicture}[
    node distance=1.5cm,
    % Define ALL node styles here before any \node commands:
    box/.style={
      rectangle, draw=navy, fill=navy!8, rounded corners=3pt,
      minimum width=3.2cm, minimum height=0.9cm,
      font=\footnotesize\sffamily, text width=3cm, align=center
    },
    arrow/.style={-Stealth, thick, draw=navy!70}
    % Add additional styles as needed
  ]

    % ---- NODE DEFINITIONS ----
    % Use semantic names (not node1, node2)
    % Use relative positioning (right=of, below=of)
    % Example:
    % \node (first_step) [box] {First Step};
    % \node (second_step) [box, below=of first_step] {Second Step};

    % ---- EDGE DEFINITIONS ----
    % Example:
    % \draw [arrow] (first_step) -- (second_step);
    % \draw [arrow] (first_step) -- node[above, font=\scriptsize\sffamily] {label} (other_node);

  \end{tikzpicture}
  \caption{[CAPTION TEXT. Use sentence case. If adapted from a source,
            add: Adapted from Author (Year).]}
  \label{fig:[SEMANTIC-LABEL]}
\end{figure}
% In-text reference: "As shown in Figure~\ref{fig:[SEMANTIC-LABEL]}, ..."
```

## LaTeX Wrapper — Multi-Panel (TikZ with subcaption)

Use when a single diagram must be split into two panels.

```latex
% ============================================================
% Figure D[N]: [DIAGRAM_TITLE] (A) and (B)
% Generated by: diagram_master_agent (Dr. Atlas)
% Category: [1–13] | Engine: TikZ | Panels: 2
%
% Required preamble additions:
%   \usepackage{tikz}
%   \usepackage{subcaption}
%   \usetikzlibrary{[REQUIRED_LIBRARIES]}
% ============================================================
\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \centering
  \begin{subfigure}[b]{0.48\textwidth}
    \centering
    \begin{tikzpicture}[
      node distance=1.4cm
      % styles here
    ]
      % Panel A content
    \end{tikzpicture}
    \caption{[Panel A caption]}
    \label{fig:[LABEL]-a}
  \end{subfigure}
  \hfill
  \begin{subfigure}[b]{0.48\textwidth}
    \centering
    \begin{tikzpicture}[
      node distance=1.4cm
      % styles here
    ]
      % Panel B content
    \end{tikzpicture}
    \caption{[Panel B caption]}
    \label{fig:[LABEL]-b}
  \end{subfigure}
  \caption{[Overall caption describing both panels.]}
  \label{fig:[LABEL]}
\end{figure}
% In-text reference: "Figure~\ref{fig:[LABEL]}(a) shows... while (b) shows..."
```

## LaTeX Wrapper — PGFPlots (Category 13)

```latex
% ============================================================
% Figure D[N]: [DIAGRAM_TITLE]
% Generated by: diagram_master_agent (Dr. Atlas)
% Category: 13 — Mathematical Function Plot
% Engine: PGFPlots
%
% Required preamble additions:
%   \usepackage{pgfplots}
%   \pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
% ============================================================
\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \centering
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \begin{axis}[
      width=0.85\columnwidth,
      height=6cm,
      xlabel={[X-AXIS LABEL]},
      ylabel={[Y-AXIS LABEL]},
      xlabel style={font=\footnotesize\sffamily},
      ylabel style={font=\footnotesize\sffamily},
      tick label style={font=\scriptsize\sffamily},
      grid=major,
      grid style={dashed, gray!30},
      axis lines=left,
      legend style={font=\scriptsize\sffamily, at={(0.98,0.95)}, anchor=north east}
    ]
      % Add plots:
      % \addplot[thick, color=navy, domain=A:B, samples=150] {EXPRESSION};
      % \addlegendentry{[Legend label]}
    \end{axis}
  \end{tikzpicture}
  \caption{[CAPTION TEXT.]}
  \label{fig:[SEMANTIC-LABEL]}
\end{figure}
```

## Markdown Wrapper (Mermaid — Draft/Secondary Engine Only)

Use ONLY when LaTeX is not required. Always include the draft comment.

````markdown
<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Figure D[N]: [DIAGRAM_TITLE]                                 -->
<!-- diagram_master_agent (Dr. Atlas) | Category [1–13]           -->
<!-- Engine: Mermaid (draft) | Necessity: [1–5]/5                 -->
<!-- Mermaid draft — generate TikZ for final LaTeX                -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->

```mermaid
---
title: [DIAGRAM_TITLE]
---
[DIAGRAM_TYPE]
    [CONTENT]
```

**Figure [N].** [Caption text in bold. Source attribution if applicable.]
````

## Preamble Injection Block Template

Add this consolidated block to the LaTeX document preamble once, covering all diagrams in the paper. Remove lines for packages not used by any diagram.

```latex
% ================================================================
% diagram_master_agent preamble additions — add to document preamble
% ================================================================
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{positioning, arrows.meta, shapes.geometric, calc, fit}

% Category 6 (taxonomy trees):
% \usepackage{forest}

% Category 8 (commutative diagrams):
% \usepackage{tikz-cd}

% Category 12 (state machines):
% \usetikzlibrary{automata}

% Category 13 (function plots):
% \usepackage{pgfplots}
% \pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}

% Multi-panel figures:
% \usepackage{subcaption}

% Academic color palette (define once):
\definecolor{navy}{RGB}{0,31,63}
\definecolor{acadteal}{RGB}{0,128,128}
\definecolor{acadcrimson}{RGB}{153,0,0}
\definecolor{acadgold}{RGB}{180,130,0}
\definecolor{acadslate}{RGB}{90,100,110}
% ================================================================
```
